utility: Florida Power & Light - Northwest Florida (former Gulf Power)
schedule: RS-1 Residential Service with Northwest Florida transition rider
sources: Florida PSC, 'Total Cost for 1,000 kWh - Residential Service', March 2026 (period January-December 2026): https://www.floridapsc.com/pscfiles/website-files/PDF/Utilities/Electricgas/BillingAdjustments/ba_total-2026_oldmar26.pdf
notes: Same RS-1 base and clause rates as FPL; differs only by the transition rider.
PSC October 1, 2026 table lists the former-Gulf transition rider as +$4.21 per 1,000 kWh (vs. FPL's -$0.40 credit). Modeled as a flat 0.421 cents/kWh; that per-kWh treatment is an assumption.
Taxes, franchise fees and other local charges are excluded.
version_note: Same RS-1 rates as FPL's January 2026 insert; unchanged through August per the PSC's March and August tables.
